hypotheses.title: Consensus Cash Flow Yield Horizon & Liquidity Dampener (analyst4 unmined cfps)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Operating cash flow per share forecast yield (anl4_afv4_cfps_median / close) provides an unmanipulated fundamental anchor against earnings management and accrual inflation. Evaluating the 180-day historical percentile rank of forward cash flow yield relative to historical trading levels within each subindustry identifies structurally undervalued cash generators, while a modest short-term price reversal buffer dampens execution friction and elevates turnover into the optimal 12%-16% fitness sweet-spot.
confounders: Sudden corporate capex expansions temporarily depressing near-term free cash flow
Analyst forecast revision lag during macroeconomic turning points
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if capital-intensive, negative-cashflow speculative equities outperform sustainable cash generators across subindustries.

candidates.rationale: 180-day percentile rank of consensus cashflow per share yield with 3-day liquidity reversal buffer

hypotheses.title: Options Term Structure Realized Variance Mispricing (Dense 1-Year Horizon)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Direct architectural calibration of the top-performing options anomaly on BRAIN (which delivered Sharpe 2.16 and Fitness 1.55 in ff15b378). Normalizing 360-day implied call volatility by 90-day realized volatility with a dense 120-day backfill eliminates instrument sparsity and weight concentration spikes, harvesting unhedged variance risk premia across TOP3000.
confounders: Protracted volatility backwardation regimes during severe systemic liquidity shocks
Sparse options quoting in illiquid small-cap names
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha inverts if market-wide realized volatility persistently exceeds option market implied pricing over prolonged multi-quarter horizons.

candidates.rationale: 360-day implied over 90-day realized volatility ratio with 120-day dense backfill and short-term price dampener

hypotheses.title: Quarterly Sales Yield Velocity & Cyclical Value Re-rating
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Net sales represent the pure top-line revenue capacity of the enterprise before capital structure or accounting adjustments. Evaluating the trailing 1-year rolling percentile rank of quarterly sales relative to current equity price (actual_sales_value_quarter / close) isolates revenue compounders trading at extreme valuation discounts. Pairing with 5-day reversal removes liquidity friction and enhances sub-universe consistency.
confounders: Unprofitable hyper-growth firms burning cash despite high top-line revenue
Broad cyclical deceleration in corporate capital expenditure
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha underperforms during speculative momentum runs where low-sales, high-valuation story stocks trade without multiple discipline.

candidates.rationale: Trailing 252-day percentile rank of sales yield to price with 5-day short-term reversal buffer
